name: anim_jyu_slide_loop
subject: a huge, heavy bear man made of glossy brown paint with messy cream splotches and a big round belly
desc: Loop: lying flat on his big belly with arms stretched forward, he slides along slurping and squelching on a slick of his own paint, the belly and flesh rippling and wobbling, thick paint smearing, bubbling and splashing up in sticky spurts around the belly and arms, drops flying back. He stays in place in the frame. The face keeps the same thick angular eyebrows, half-lidded eyes and closed mouth. Thick, wet, sticky, viscous paint.
